description: Ex-SAAF Puma displayed in the grounds of the National Zoological Garden in Pretoria, listed on the SAAF's inventory of ex-SAAF airframes displayed away from air force property. The only dated photograph of 133 found is from Hoedspruit in September 1985 while it was still in service with 31 Squadron, so the zoo placement rests on the SAAF list alone and its continued presence is unconfirmed.
